The examination establishes that the headline transformer results are bounded and explained by non-stratum protocol mechanisms—specifically a 1,572.5x parameter-scale/architecture boundary where static weight auditing had 0/4 detections on Gemma-3-270M, and 25,600 forward-pass token evaluations used to ablate a 93.0% repetition-loop decoding pathology on Qwen3.5-0.8B rather than zero-execution weight programming.

The examination sustains the original experimental tables while demonstrating that the reported effects are bounded by non-stratum mechanisms—specifically the forward-pass protocol regime (25,600 calibration token evaluations) and decoding pathology ablation (rank-1 repetition loop suppression)—rather than zero-execution static weight programming at transformer scale.
